title: FMSNO: Scaling Surface Neural Operators by Learned Flow Matching Reparametrisation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose the Flow Matching Surface Neural Operator (FMSNO), which combines learning a shared map from irregular surface meshes to a regular two-dimensional grid on the sphere and training a neural operator on the regular grid. Constructing a separate map for each new geometry can dominate inference time on large meshes. We initially pretrain the mapping by flow matching using precomputed optimal transport maps as targets and then continue its training using combined geometry and CFD objectives. We apply it to unseen geometries in a single forward pass. The learned flow deforms the surface points, and we project its endpoints onto the sphere. We then splat geometric features onto the spherical grid, apply a neural operator (we tested both Fourier and Spherical Fourier Neural Operators), and interpolate its output back to the surface. For a mesh with $N$ points, evaluating the map costs O(N), and the full prediction costs O(NlogN) with t

translated_title: FMSNO：通过学习的流匹配重参数化扩展表面神经算子
translated_abstract: 我们提出了流匹配表面神经算子，它结合了学习一个从不规则表面网格到球面上规则二维网格的共享映射，以及在规则网格上训练神经算子。为每个新几何体构建单独的映射可能会在大网格上占据推理时间的主要部分。我们首先使用预计算的最优传输映射作为目标，通过流匹配对该映射进行预训练，然后使用几何与计算流体动力学（CFD）相结合的目标继续其训练。我们在单次前向传播中将其应用于未见过的几何体。学习的流对表面点进行变形，我们将其端点投影到球面上。然后我们将几何特征散落到球面网格上，应用神经算子（我们测试了傅里叶神经算子和球面傅里叶神经算子），并将其输出插值回表面。对于一个具有 N 个点的网格，评估该映射的成本为 O(N)，完整预测的成本为 O(N log N)。
tldr: 该论文提出FMSNO，通过流匹配学习从不规则表面网格到球面规则网格的共享重参数化映射，再在规则网格上应用神经算子，从而实现对未见几何体的单次前向传播快速预测，且计算复杂度仅为O(N log N)。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FMSNO, which learns a shared flow-matching-based reparameterisation from irregular surface meshes to a regular spherical grid and applies neural operators on the grid, enabling fast single-forward-pass predictions on unseen geometries with O(N log N) complexity.
